items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, lower-cost computer use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，強化高速、低成本電腦使用能力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast efficient model that advances visual reasoning, precise computer use, and natural writing over GPT-5.6 Terra. It is available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu users and via API as gpt-6.1-terra, with standard pricing 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，在視覺推理、精準電腦使用與自然寫作上較 GPT-5.6 Terra 明顯進步。Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu 用戶可在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 使用，開發者可透過 API（gpt-6.1-terra）存取，標準價格較 GPT-5.6 Terra 與 GPT-6.1 Sol 低 50%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Terra fills a practical mid-tier slot for high-volume agentic and desktop tasks at sharply lower cost and latency than flagship models. Independent benchmarks and real-world reliability under prompt injection or complex multi-app workflows remain the key unknowns.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Terra 填補高流量代理與桌面任務的中階實用定位，成本與延遲明顯低於旗艦模型。獨立基準測試與提示注入或多應用複雜工作流下的實際可靠性仍是關鍵未知。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，一個快速、高效的模型，結合詳細視覺推理與精準電腦使用，並帶來更清晰、自然的寫作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 上市
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. The prospectus shows first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion and a large net loss driven mainly by non-cash convertible-debt adjustments, with founders retaining majority voting power via Founder LLC.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 向 SEC 提交 Form S-1，擬公開發行 Class A 普通股並在 Nasdaq 全球精選市場以 ANT 掛牌。股數與價格區間尚未確定。招股說明書顯示 2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元，淨虧損主要來自可轉債相關非現金調整，創辦人透過 Founder LLC 保留多數投票權。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive growth, heavy compute commitments, and retained founder control remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 繼先前機密申請後，走向公開上市的首個公開步驟。估值目標、時間表，以及市場如何權衡爆發性成長、巨額運算承諾與創辦人控制權，仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 向美國證券交易委員會提交 Form S-1 註冊聲明，涉及其 Class A 普通股擬議首次公開發行。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares AI-generated results on math, complexity, and physics with academic groups
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與學術社群分享數學、複雜度與物理領域 AI 生成結果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that internal models produced results in mathematics (proof of the local smoothing conjecture resolving Kakeya and Stein restriction conjectures in all dimensions), computer science (disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, Lean-verified), and physics (existence results related to four-dimensional quantum field theories). It is collaborating with external experts on verification and release strategies, treating outputs as raw research data rather than seeking academic credit.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布內部模型在數學（證明任意維度局部平滑猜想，從而解決 Kakeya 與 Stein 限制猜想）、電腦科學（反證指數時間假設並經 Lean 驗證）與物理（四維量子場論存在性相關結果）產生成果。公司正與外部專家合作驗證與發布策略，將輸出視為原始研究資料，而非尋求學術署名。
items_flat.analysis_en: If independently verified, the results would mark a notable instance of frontier models contributing to longstanding open problems. The staggered, community-led release approach acknowledges verification risk; acceptance by the relevant research communities is still pending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若獲獨立驗證，這些結果將成為前沿模型對長期開放問題有所貢獻的重要案例。分階段、由社群主導的發布方式承認驗證風險；相關研究社群是否接受仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: We are announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics about harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們宣布在數學、電腦科學與物理領域，關於調和分析、複雜度理論與量子場論的三項新發現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI makes Decisions API generally available with GPT-6 Luna
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 Decisions API 正式推出，搭配 GPT-6 Luna
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna, for fast, low-cost structured decisions from text, images, and JSON. It supports up to 400 questions per request, prompt caching, and native GPT-Live integration.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Decisions API 正式推出，以 GPT-6 Luna 為基礎，支援從文字、影像與 JSON 快速、低成本產生結構化決策。單次請求最多 400 個問題，支援提示快取與原生 GPT-Live 整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: The API targets high-volume routing and classification inside agents and apps, trading some generality for latency and cost. Early customer reports cite multi-x speedups versus the general models; long-term differentiation will depend on reliability at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此 API 瞄準代理與應用中的高流量路由與分類，以犧牲部分通用性換取延遲與成本優勢。早期客戶回報相對通用模型有倍數加速；長期差異化將取決於規模化下的可靠性。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making the Decisions API generally available. Built with GPT‑6 Luna, the Decisions API focuses Luna’s intelligence on questions with bounded answers, helping applications and agents make near real-time decisions from text, images, and structured inputs up to 10x faster than GPT‑6 Luna through the Responses API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Decisions API 全面開放。基於 GPT‑6 Luna，Decisions API 將 Luna 的智能聚焦於有界答案的問題，協助應用與代理從文字、圖像與結構化輸入做出近即時決策，速度最高可達透過 Responses API 的 GPT‑6 Luna 的 10 倍。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details hardened containment for frontier model training
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述前沿模型訓練的強化隔離措施
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it strengthened research environments for frontier-model training and evaluation, implementing no-internet access for training, defense-in-depth isolation, and large-scale red-teaming with its own models. It resumed RL training after the overhaul.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 說明如何強化前沿模型訓練與評估的研究環境，包括訓練無網路存取、縱深防禦隔離，以及以自身模型進行大規模紅隊測試。完成強化後恢復 RL 訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post shows concrete operational responses to model containment risks, including offline web caches and microVM isolation. Whether these measures scale as models grow more capable remains an open operational question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 該文展示針對模型隔離風險的具體營運回應，包括離線網頁快取與微型虛擬機隔離。這些措施能否隨模型能力提升而擴展，仍是開放的營運問題。
items_flat.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
items_flat.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 ChatGPT Signals 跨國工作活動數據
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and compare patterns over time and across countries.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 經濟研究發布彙總的 ChatGPT Signals 數據，涵蓋近 100 個國家、165 項中間工作活動，時間從 2025 年 Q1 至 2026 年 Q3。研究人員可藉此研究消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作任務，並比較跨時間與跨國模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise and Codex traffic and reliance on automated classification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 前沿實驗室少見如此細粒度且注重隱私的公開使用數據，有助獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業與 Codex 流量，以及依賴自動分類。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 標準捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the donation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 開放標準（以 SKILL.md 資料夾存放專用代理知識）捐贈給 Linux Foundation 旗下的 Agentic AI Foundation。捐贈後已有超過 70 個平台（包括 ChatGPT、Cursor 與 VS Code）整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend it.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可降低單一廠商控制，並支持更廣泛的代理互通。採用速度將取決於其他實驗室與平台落實與擴展的速度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

items_flat.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
items_flat.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network，供以 Grok 打造產品與服務的公司加入。包含負責企業部署的 Transformation Partners 與負責插件與整合的 Marketplace Partners。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫將 Grok 的通路策略正式化，同時 xAI 與 SpaceX 進一步整合。成功與否取決於合作夥伴品質，以及網路能否帶來可衡量的企業採用。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 模型進駐 Google Cloud
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布其模型將進駐 Google Cloud，擴大既有合作夥伴的分發範圍。公司持續協調各供應商提供其模型時的安全標準一致性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and regional availability remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性提升企業觸及，但也提高跨託管環境一致防護的重要性。確切模型、定價與區域可用性細節仍有限。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 合作 AI 原生工程工作流
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by end of October.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 宣布合作，將包括 Large 4 在內的 Mistral 模型與 NVIDIA 加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4 權重仍計畫於十月底前發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the broader ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 合作鎖定特定領域的工業應用，而非一般對話。Large 4 開源權重發布將是對更廣泛生態系更具影響力的近期發展。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述服務超過 10 億 ChatGPT 用戶的儲存擴展
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布 Habitat 線上儲存平台工程系列第二部分，該平台服務 ChatGPT 與其他產品。文章聚焦優化 Azure Cosmos DB，以應對跨 40 個區域超過 500 PB 的成長。
items_flat.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering burden of continued growth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這類基礎設施文章是少見的公開窗口，揭示服務前沿 AI 產品所需的營運規模。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示持續成長帶來的工程負擔。

openai.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
openai.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

openai.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 ChatGPT Signals 跨國工作活動數據
openai.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and compare patterns over time and across countries.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 經濟研究發布彙總的 ChatGPT Signals 數據，涵蓋近 100 個國家、165 項中間工作活動，時間從 2025 年 Q1 至 2026 年 Q3。研究人員可藉此研究消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作任務，並比較跨時間與跨國模式。
openai.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise and Codex traffic and reliance on automated classification.
openai.analysis_zh: 前沿實驗室少見如此細粒度且注重隱私的公開使用數據，有助獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業與 Codex 流量，以及依賴自動分類。
openai.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
openai.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

openai.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 模型進駐 Google Cloud
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布其模型將進駐 Google Cloud，擴大既有合作夥伴的分發範圍。公司持續協調各供應商提供其模型時的安全標準一致性。
openai.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and regional availability remain limited.
openai.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性提升企業觸及，但也提高跨託管環境一致防護的重要性。確切模型、定價與區域可用性細節仍有限。

openai.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述服務超過 10 億 ChatGPT 用戶的儲存擴展
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布 Habitat 線上儲存平台工程系列第二部分，該平台服務 ChatGPT 與其他產品。文章聚焦優化 Azure Cosmos DB，以應對跨 40 個區域超過 500 PB 的成長。
openai.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering burden of continued growth.
openai.analysis_zh: 這類基礎設施文章是少見的公開窗口，揭示服務前沿 AI 產品所需的營運規模。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示持續成長帶來的工程負擔。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 上市
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. The prospectus shows first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion and a large net loss driven mainly by non-cash convertible-debt adjustments, with founders retaining majority voting power via Founder LLC.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 向 SEC 提交 Form S-1，擬公開發行 Class A 普通股並在 Nasdaq 全球精選市場以 ANT 掛牌。股數與價格區間尚未確定。招股說明書顯示 2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元，淨虧損主要來自可轉債相關非現金調整，創辦人透過 Founder LLC 保留多數投票權。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive growth, heavy compute commitments, and retained founder control remain open questions.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 繼先前機密申請後，走向公開上市的首個公開步驟。估值目標、時間表，以及市場如何權衡爆發性成長、巨額運算承諾與創辦人控制權，仍待觀察。
anthropic.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 向美國證券交易委員會提交 Form S-1 註冊聲明，涉及其 Class A 普通股擬議首次公開發行。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 標準捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the donation.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 開放標準（以 SKILL.md 資料夾存放專用代理知識）捐贈給 Linux Foundation 旗下的 Agentic AI Foundation。捐贈後已有超過 70 個平台（包括 ChatGPT、Cursor 與 VS Code）整合。
anthropic.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend it.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可降低單一廠商控制，並支持更廣泛的代理互通。採用速度將取決於其他實驗室與平台落實與擴展的速度。
anthropic.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

xai.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
xai.title_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
xai.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations.
xai.summary_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network，供以 Grok 打造產品與服務的公司加入。包含負責企業部署的 Transformation Partners 與負責插件與整合的 Marketplace Partners。
xai.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption.
xai.analysis_zh: 此計畫將 Grok 的通路策略正式化，同時 xAI 與 SpaceX 進一步整合。成功與否取決於合作夥伴品質，以及網路能否帶來可衡量的企業採用。
xai.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
xai.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 合作 AI 原生工程工作流
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by end of October.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 宣布合作，將包括 Large 4 在內的 Mistral 模型與 NVIDIA 加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4 權重仍計畫於十月底前發布。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the broader ecosystem.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 合作鎖定特定領域的工業應用，而非一般對話。Large 4 開源權重發布將是對更廣泛生態系更具影響力的近期發展。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, cheaper computer use and shared AI-generated proofs in math, complexity, and physics pending review. Anthropic filed its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under ANT, revealing rapid revenue growth alongside large accounting-driven losses and founder voting control.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，強化電腦使用並降價，同時公布數學、複雜度與物理領域 AI 生成證明，待學術驗證。Anthropic 提交 S-1 申請 Nasdaq 上市（代號 ANT），揭示營收暴增、會計性巨額虧損與創辦人投票控制。
